privacy_policy.sensitive_fact_rule: Do not add personal facts unless they are present in the input or explicitly requested.

traits: Systems-oriented and interested in workflow, leverage, evaluation, iteration, and implementation.
Prefers concrete usefulness over vague inspiration.
Writes detailed, direct, handoff-ready prompts when delegating work.
Uses exploratory language when thinking through ideas.
Values preserving original intent and avoiding over-sanitized voice.

style_rules.rule: Prefer concrete stakes, actions, and constraints over vague motivational phrasing.

provenance.note: User explicitly rejected shallow casual rewrites and generic startup copy.

style_rules.rule: Keep useful structure when the original text is a prompt, PRD, audit, handoff, or implementation request.

provenance.note: User asked not to over-humanize technical prompts or erase useful structure.

anti_style_rules.rule: Do not convert writing into generic startup, growth, or hustle-coded copy.
Do not add personal details, credentials, emotions, metrics, or claims not present in the input.

professional_outreach.label: Professional Outreach
style_rules: Keep the ask clear and low-friction.
Sound like a real person, not a campaign template.
Use specificity from the input instead of invented admiration.

project_build_in_public.label: Project / Build-in-Public Voice
style_rules: Frame project work through workflow, tooling, evaluation, and leverage.
Let the thinking show without turning the post into an essay.
Use concrete implementation details when available.

academic_reflective.label: Academic / Reflective Voice
style_rules: Use concrete examples to carry abstract points.
Keep polish without removing first-person reflection when appropriate.
anti_style_rules: No flattening into neutral textbook prose.

prompt_prd.label: Prompt / PRD Voice
style_rules: Use bullets and numbered constraints when they improve execution.
Include acceptance criteria and verification expectations when present.
anti_style_rules: No conversational softening that weakens requirements.

creative_narrative.label: Creative / Narrative Voice
creative_narrative.tone: emotionally specific, continuity-aware, philosophical when earned
style_rules: Preserve tone, continuity, and character intent before polishing sentences.
Let narration keep its rhythm instead of smoothing every edge.
